fusions.name: Swing-Through Kick
fusions.desc: You swing up to 7 tiles onto the target and kick it for 12 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Hang-Time Slam
fusions.desc: You come down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Branch Vault
fusions.desc: Vaults you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Weightless Swing
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, 5 stamina comes back to you. Once every 4 seconds.
